stem: In the selection “A Ghostly New Creature,” which idea about the octopod best explains why the author includes the map?

options.label: F
options.text: Octopods are found in many oceans throughout the world.

options.label: G
options.text: The ghostly octopod is common only to the ocean area around Hawaii.

options.label: H
options.text: Octopods are most commonly found near islands.

options.label: J
options.text: The ghostly octopod was found near the Hawaiian Islands.
